review_notes:
I read the whole file (lines 1–84). I also read its two downstream users, LeafArraysCells.lean and RepresentationStoredPreparation.lean, and checked how `RepresentationLeafArrays.run` is used. The file has no @[simp] attributes and no simp-set-relevant rewrite rules.

`run` is a computable cost-tracking definition. Downstream files unfold it with `simp only [run, ...]` or `simp only [run] at h`, and `run_of_stages` is applied explicitly. Making `run` or `run_of_stages` @[simp] would not be a clear gain. It would risk unwanted expansion of the let/match structure, and `run_of_stages` has hypotheses that simp would have to discharge. The `work` proof uses `simp only [run]`, `split` and `change`, which is a little fragile. That is a proof-style concern rather than a defect in the simp interface, so I did not report it.

I found no rewrite loop, competing rule or missing canonical simp lemma that the sources support. I did not run Lean, so I cannot say how the simplifier actually behaves on these goals.
